integrity: Analytic asymptotic proof plus independent quadrature and Monte Carlo corroboration; no independent mathematical or historical validation.
scientific_limitations: Only three independent area-uniform points on the round two-sphere, with no asserted rate of total-variation convergence; prior full shape-density literature remains a historical-priority risk. The scalar perimeter density and its singularity were already known.
title: A circular-ensemble boundary law for nearly maximal spherical triangle perimeters
